notes.title: New Maps
notes.content:
[b]Greetings players![/b]

April brought to us spring, warm weather and the first [b]Drabidiboo[/b]'s monthly update!!!

Let's look to its content...

[h1]Crystal Cavern (map)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/c02ccfbaa74d6f488448a550140f0f8f9ed155f9.png[/img]

Narrow corridors make this map perfect for brawlers Pet. Spiders shine on this one because they can use the walls to adjust their movement and with their paralysis moves it's easy to set up deadly traps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/40cff18a7d674c925c273acec5bfcc0a0f06130e.png[/img]

[h1]Howling Forest (map)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/0e5b442d76ce5e18b173661a61a02a583ed18b8b.png[/img]

This map offers big area and several single box barrier for long range Pets and runners. It has a big fighting zone in the middle that is perfect for cone attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/dfa1d0b2c2ff8263ea70d6879a6421cc367d57f0.png[/img]

[h1]Wuthering Peak (map)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/404d767efc07ae9ee1f066aa984897d638ff63e5.png[/img]

This map has been designed for ambushes. Every gems can be guarded from a safe point and even those in the top corner offer a smart coverage for getting behind the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/2700e55783196db54435807bc2ab6fcf7458aabd.png[/img]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mokkan Wood map has been tuned
[*] AI has been improved (it's still not perfect, but a big step in the right direction has been made)
[*] stability fix for macOS client on Catalina
[*] various minor bugfixes (typos, glitches...)
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings players!

I'm very happy to introduce you to [b]Drabidiboo: Combat Pets[/b]!
After 10 months of development, the very first public early access release is now available to get played.

Even though the game isn't finished yet, the core features and gameplay mechanics are ready. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/cdceab239ad94aa14fe575736891ca94f2c811a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/f2080c110ae12bce1d8482519968ca1acbf241c4.png[/img][/url]
[h2] What is "Drabidiboo"? [/h2]
[b]Drabidiboo[/b] is a turn-based strategy game of prediction with a strong meta component, containing a large set of Pets to collect and use to build up your team.

Two players compete to gather the most gems on a 10x10 board. The moves and actions are all declared simultaneously so outsmarting the opponent is key; attack, defend or use the board layout to your advantage.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/ae27cc8ab40728f5944c374fed5c6b056c93a0ec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/12eacd39f19deaf504967d259ed6d15051ff5ced.png[/img][/url]

[h2] What's in the Early Access build? [/h2]
A vertical slice of the game is available to be played but please keep in mind that the game is still in development.

Some of these features could not be 100% finished, some corners need to be polished and of course there could be some bugs that will need to get debugged! :D

The downloadable client's version is 0.12* and it contains:
[list][*] Login system.
[*] Onboarding (Starter Pets assignment) + Tutorial map.
[*] Single player and Multiplayer mode on a test map.
[*] Treasury with Loot Chest Catalog and "Open+Obtain" system (to get new pets).
[*] Collection view + Team Builder.
[*] Quest Log + Quest Lottery.
[*] An early set of 48 Pets with 116 different actions.
[*] Settings + Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
[/list]

As I already mentioned, even if the client is stable we shall still consider it a beta for now: it will be tuned for better performance soon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/0f6196ff695b9183750f2e548e2dfede72e1dca2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/dff7f564ac5a6a09b4b2e1feae6a9a9e8bc97f0b.png[/img][/url]

[h2] How can I help you? [/h2]
The goal of this Early Access stage is to shape together the game by playing it.
It is super important for me to understand what you like and what you don't.

To help me in the development process there are some simple operations you can do:
[list]
[*] [b]Follow[/b] the game in the Steam Store, to stay updated with latest news.
[*] If you like to be an early adopter get a copy of the game, otherwise please add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b] to be ready to get it when it will be fully released.
[*] Talk about DBDBoo with your friends and share it as much as possible on your social media. It's just a couple of clicks for you that would give a huge help for the game to grow.
[*] Keep in touch with me and share your toughts and feedbacks.
[*] Report any bug and anomaly you find.
[/list]

A Dev Diary is going to be published to keep you updated about the development progress of Drabidiboo. 
You are welcome to leave comments about what you would like to get done first.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/122f244c27d711be6c7821917f9de2dfaa429d0a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873417/52d795c9f44eda363383cdf86faad316c91e2ac7.png[/img][/url]

[h2] What's the plan for the future? [/h2]
I have a lot of plans about the final version of the games and the features I would like to implement, many on them have already been groomed and planned for the next sprints, but the feedback from the community will be crucial to understand what is really needed and what is not.

[h3] Desired visuals features [/h3]
[list][*] VFX+SFX: More Pets animations and sounds for actions.
[*] Client performance optimization.
[*] Lights and particle effects optimization.
[*] New shaders.
[*] Pet declaration card needs to be reworked.
[*] Game Splash with Video Intro.
[*] Pet color variants and premium skins.
[/list]
[h3] Desired Gameplay features [/h3]
[list][*] "Paralysis" status.
[*] META fine tuning (reiterate this ticket if needed).
[*] 4x PvP maps for weekly events.
[*] Daily Rewards for returning players.
[*] Roguelike story mode (single player campaign).
[*] AI: make it smarter.
[*] Replace "End Turn" button with a timer for multiplayer games.
[*] Tournament mode (online and offline).
[*] Add custom [i]DEPLOY[/i] and [i]REVEAL[/i] phase.
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Legendary Elite loot chest for "Early Access Pack"
[*] Wondertrade
[/list]
[h3] Known bugs [/h3]
[list][*] For very wide screen, first run has wrong resolution.
[*] Matchmaking queue timeout.
[*] Backend tuning.
[*] MacOS client needs to be tuned and optimized (expecially on Big Sur).
[/list]
[h3] Nice to Have [/h3]
[list][*] Multilanguage support and translations.
[*] iPAD porting.
[*] Android tablet porting.
[*] Pet market or auction house (for players' pets trading)[/list]
